This is the home of the wealthy and eccentric Mr. Belmont. Little is known about the reclusive Mr. Belmont, except that he is VERY rich.
This is the Thieves' Guild, led by the mysterious Keef the Thief. It is said he came from another world.

This huge fortress is built on the ruins of a destroyed city.

Greetings.
Hello.

Welcome.

Goodbye.

You must TALK to someone before attacking them.
I'm sorry, I don't have anything to sell.
I'm sorry, you don't have anything I want to buy.

Right, good job.

Bye!
See ya!

<NA>
Pssst! How about 10 gold?
Would you do me a favor for 10 gold?
Thanks.
Take a look at this.
You have nothing that interests me.
Please answer the question.
I have nothing more to say on that topic.
Yes, of course.
No, not at all.
I haven't asked you a question.
Life is pain and anyone telling you differently is selling something.
Things were better before the Cataclysm. Void -- may he be cursed forever -- brought evil into the world.
Nexus has forsaken us. Evil dwells again in the world as it never did before the coming of Void.
I'm having a really bad day.
Its always nice to meet a Sorcerer -- you folks really have good heads on your shoulders.
Sorcerers have meddled enough in my affairs.  I wish Nexus had never given the Power to any of you.
I can't talk for long, I'm very busy.
<NA>
We've had a nice stretch of sunny days of late.
Halt! Who goes there?
I really can't stand around here gabbing with you.
We guards are an honorable lot. To become a guard you have to have special training and take an oath of loyalty.
Let us do our job.
There is nothing I like better than pacing the street late at night.
I am a guard.
Violence has been on the rise lately. Guards are in high demand.
How dare you insult my honor by trying to bribe me.
I'm the town jailer. Don't try to help the prisoner escape.
No one has ever escaped my jail -- I'm always on the lookout for those blasted Flipstones!
Hey there traveler, welcome to the best tavern in town. Let me know if you want a drink.
Stop me if you've heard this one: A Red Priest and a Black Priest walk into a tavern...
I am a tavern keeper -- I serve, I listen to the woes of my patrons, and  I tell bad jokes to cheer them up!
I am doing well. These are trying times we live in. People need a place where they can relax and meditate while drinking a cool drink.
Welcome to my store. What can I do for you?
I sell food, water and trade goods.
Trade makes the world go round. One can always earn a living trading goods between cities.
The Fount of Heaven is the spiritual center of the world. The City of Commerce is the financial center.
Welcome, young Sorcerer, you look tired. We rent the softest beds on this side of the continent.
I run an inn. You can stay the night here, or get a good meal.
I like to believe that my inn offers a little island of security for the weary traveler.
We get a lively night crowd at this inn. Not so rowdy as the local bar, but  fun just the same.
Hello, Sir! Welcome to the Vehicle Depot.
I manage the depot here. I deal in boats, ships and beasts.
Everyone needs good transportation.
There are several ways to get from place to place. You can go on foot, by beast, or you can get a sea-going vessel.
There are two types of beasts: the large land beasts called Dinos, and the winged beasts called Dragons.
Dinos are good for open terrain, but can't handle forests or mountains. Dragons can fly over any terrain, but can only land in a clearing.
Finally, there are two types of water craft: small boats for rivers and shallows, and ships for deep water.
Hello. I'm the lighthouse keeper.
I maintain the lighthouse and make sure that the light stays lit.
It's important that the lighthouse light never goes out, so passing ships won't wreck upon the rocks.
This lighthouse was built after the terrible disaster of 422, when a storm drove three City of Commerce trade ships onto the rocks, killing scores of men.
Greetings Sorcerer, I am the Mayor of this town.
I handle all sorts of civic duties; saftey, trade, and taxation, among others.
Most towns, including ours, have adopted a standard form of civic government. They elect a mayor to monitor town institutions.
Running this town is pretty easy -- Sorcerers are an orderly and peaceful lot.
Knights pretty much run their own town. They follow the rules of Separation.
Thanks, the town appreciates your support.
Hello Buc. How'd you do on the examination?
Have you heard about the Master's discovery?
Master Thalmus was on sabbatical for the last several months.
He was working with a team of researchers on the legend of the lost Rings of Power.
He is going to call a meeting soon to announce their findings.
I study Sorcery at the Academy of the Mind, Buc. Just like you.
I will become a powerful Mindist.
It is exciting to be at the greatest center of Sorcery in the world. Some of history's most powerful Sorcerers have been graduates of the Academy.
Balfour Big-Brain who lived in the second century was an Academy grad, and he invented the MIRAGE skill!
What's up, friend? Buy us a round?
Get outta here Sorcerer!
<Hic>
Go away! I didn't build a house in the middle of nowhere to be bothered by the likes of you.
I have not spoken in years. Now I remember why.
Are you still here?
Do you know what I do? I sit here in the wilderness and contemplate the things I hate most in life.
There will always be some of us who just don't fit into normal society. Don't mind me, I like it out here.
Good bye, traveler. Please don't come back.
You're one of those Sorcerers aren't you? I HATE Sorcerers! Why are you bothering me?
I used to be a mighty Sorcerer, but Thalmus gave me the boot -- now I do nothing!
Stop meddling with my life!
Out! I said get out! Are you deaf or something? I don't want to talk to you!
Time to die, Sorcerer!
Why hello Buc, what can I do for you?
You show great promise, Buc. Nexus has graced you with great discipline. Mind your studies and you'll be a great Sorcerer some day.
Goodbye Buc. We'll talk again soon.
I spend my days teaching students like yourself the Art and Discipline of Sorcery so that one day they may use their talents to better the world.
Buc -- you got my note. I hope the other students come as promptly.
Let's go to the practice room. I'd like to demonstrate the first Sorcerer's spell: STUN.
Come and see me after you have talked to Ak Thul at the Temple.
Heed the words of the priest, Buc. He is wiser than you know.
You'll find a key on the floor of my room, Buc. Use it to open the chest nearby. Inside is a map of Ushka Bau.
Use the map to find the hermit who lives in the hills to the south. Last night he was seen stealing the Eye symbol from the Academy door.
You can try talking to him, but I'm afraid he's not very reasonable.  If he won't give the Eye to you, practice your STUN spell on him.
When you have the Eye, bring it to me. I'll have the groundskeeper nail it to the door again.
You've done well, Buc. This is the second spell of Sorcery, CLUE. Check with the Guildmasters in the guildhalls to obtain your other spells.
Come with me to the practice room. I have a very important announcement to make.
Buc, you are the most promising of my students. If anything happens to me, seek my friend Hack in the City of Division.
Ah, Imino and Roakus are early, as usual, and Father Yoppa is here as well. But where are Darius and Fezzik? Will they keep us waiting again?
Ahem -- thank you all for coming. The things I must tell you are of the utmost urgency.
As you may know, I have recently been researching the origins of the Six Arts.  You are familiar with the stories of the Rings of Power, and of the Rod of Creation.
Until now these stories have been dismissed as legends, but the Six Guildmasters have uncovered evidence that the Rings of Power do indeed exist.
There are eleven Rings; they are the foundation of Nexus' power, and  the power of the Six Arts.
This has frightening implications, for when the Rings are together, they form  the Rod of Creation, the most powerful object known to us.
Void and his minions seek the Rings even as we speak. You must each form parties and find them before Void can reassemble the Rod. The locations are...
DARIUS YOU ATTACK ME! I feared that Void's influence reached this far... Students DISPERSE!
Your master's dying word forces itself into the mind of all present, scattering them across the globe.
You find yourself outside a strange city. "Seek my friend Hack..." was Thalmus' last request. Might you find him here?
Die, Thalmus!
I see we are all here, even Darius and Fezzik. Thank you for joining us, gentlemen.
Today's topic is STUN. It takes very little energy to cast, and does little damage. As you gain experience, it will become your spell of last resort.
STUN has a range of about ten feet, and gives your enemy a painful jolt. I will demonstrate...
Students, you are ready to use the STUN spell. I have a task for each of you.
Buc, Ak Thul at the Temple of Nexus has asked to see you. When you're finished there, come back and I'll give you your assignment.
Lesson over.
Greetings young Sorcerer. The passing of your master has touched me deeply.
Hello Buc. Is there something I can do to help you?
Thank you for freeing my people from the mines. I assume that Quill told you to look up our friends Xylotyl and Flemm.
I must find out where the Bandits have taken my people. Can you help? Ask around  at the Guilds -- they may have some information for you.
If you can bring me a map to the Mines of Misery, you will be rewarded.
Talk to Carp, the town gossip. He can usually be found on the docks in front of the cathedral.
Thank you for your help -- this map will help us greatly.
I know you need an Archer for your party, but my best student, Feather, is a prisoner in the Mines -- I need help in rescuing her and the others who are there.
Go to the Mines of Misery and do away with the bandits, then give this Symbol to Quill, my lieutenant. She'll allow Feather to join you.
Take that symbol to the Archer Quill in the Mines of Misery. Acording to the map they are in the hills above the falls to the east of here.
Sorry, I can't let you into the upper chambers.
You are a handsome young Sorcerer. If you bring me a bouquet of the flowers they sell in the city of Perfection, I might let you in.
You're an honorable fellow, so I'll tell you something:  there's a sextant hidden in a cave behind the falls just to the east.
Go on in -- Guildmistress Arrow is upstairs.
Pssst! Hey, get me a Flip Stone so I can get out of here and I'll tell you where the Mines of Misery are. You'd like to know that, wouldn't you?
You kept your end of the bargain, I'll keep mine: the Mines of Misery are just to the east -- here, I'll make a map for you.
By the way, when you get there check out the Archer Feather, she is good with the bow, and one hot cookie to boot.
Thanks buddy! Lenny never forgets a favor.
<Lenny Flips Out>
Hello Sorcerer. I have heard of your quest and I'm anxious to join you.
I am Quill, and you must be the Sorcerer that Thalmus told mistress Arrow about.
However, you might also be an imposter.  To prove that you were sent by Arrow, show me the Archers' symbol.
I'm pleased to present Feather, Arrow's best student. She'll be an asset to you.
It would be useful to have one member of every Discipline in your party. Their individual skills will come in handy. Talk to Flemm and Xylotyl.
You should seek the Necromancer Flemm in the city of Blood and the Enchanter Xylotyl in the city of Kaos -- they will be expecting you.
Feather has only learned the basic spells so you should take her to an Archer's guild for some new ones.
Let's get out of here. The door above has probably been sealed by now -- we'll go out the back way.
Care to hear some of the lastest gossip?
We make Flip Stones in Speed. -- they're used to "flip" you to the nearest Gateway. The old factory was in the south east corner of town.
The mayor has caught one of the bandits who raided us a couple of nights ago and has him in jail at the civic center.
Looking for gold and glory? You could kill the old witch in the fire swamp.  Better talk to the people in the Lobotomy Club first.
The Gateways will take you anywhere in the world you want to go, if you know  how to use them.
If you have enough money, you can buy Flip Stones at the General Store.
Help us please. The bandits are holding us captive.
It's nice to meet you Buc. I look forward to joining you on the Quest for the Rings. Together we shall divide the earth!
Hello Buc. Is there something more I can do for you?
So you're the young Sorcerer Thalmus was telling me about. His death only proves the urgency of your quest for the Rings.
I'll give you an opportunity to prove yourself to me: the Black Priest Scourge stole the key the chest which holds our symbol.
If you get the key from him and bring the symbol to me, I will help you. Ask about your QUEST at the Knight Guilds in town to learn Scourge's whereabouts.
Find the key, then go to our treasury and get the symbol. When you have it bring it to me and I will let Slash join your quest.
Good job, Buc. Young Slash would like to join you.
Although your party is now larger you'll need a few more to make a good, strong team.
Seek recruits among the Archers in Speed, many swords to the west.
Also, go to the Temple and ask the priests about your quest -- they'll give you some guidance. Goodbye, and good luck.
My apologies, Sorcerer. Please go in -- the gold in these chests is yours. Hack will be relieved to have the symbol once again.
Well ... I doubt if anyone will miss a few gold pieces ... go on in.
There is a scholar at the Great Cathedral who is an expert on the Ring of Division. He can tell you a great deal about it.
Hello Sorcerer. I am reading up on the ancient litany of Division. My hobby is the legends of the Ring of Division -- I am something of an expert.
So you seek the Ring of Division? Oh what I wouldn't give to be 50 years younger and join you...
According to legend the Ring of Division was given by Nexus to a young Knight named Doggon. He used it's power to found Doggania and the Doggon dynasty.
Although it is possible his descendants still have it, I don't think so. Now we will look at the Litany. In the year 7 a mad prophet spoke the following:
"Division shall be found in the form of a Division of Age and a Division of Power." This is cryptic but I have been thinking...
Doggon XXIV has been Divided from his power, the second half of this prophecy has been fulfilled. The first half has not, however, so start your quest with this:
There is a town in the far south on the polar plains where old and young live Divided. It can be found at about 3' 22'. Good luck.
I don't know where Scourge is hiding, but Rashiid the wandering merchant may be able to help you.
He mentioned that he saw a Black Priest slithering away from the Guild of Pieces just the other night.
I don't know where Rashiid is, but he leaves his whereabouts with friends the lighthouse keepers. A boat from the Vehicle Master can take you there.
Rashiid is away at his favorite oasis, restocking his fresh water supply. I'm not at liberty to tell you where it is, though... not for free, anyway.
The oasis is to the west of Division. Take your boat and hug the north wall of the city heading west to the corner.
Work your way south, and then west into the islands. His oasis is on the big island. Use your map if you get into any trouble.
When you find him, ask him about your QUEST. Make sure to question him a couple a times -- he holds out.
I know how to get into the Guild of Pieces treasury; the same way you get my fellow lighthouse keeper across the harbor to talk -- coins.
Hi, I'm the Combat Master here. Welcome to my drill room. You can fight me without either of us getting hurt. Just Flee when you are done.
How did you get in here? This is a closed service. Although I am pleased that Thalmus has gone on to greener pastures, his work must go on.
How is the quest going? Did you dig anything up?
I will allow a young Necromancer to join you if I can be certain that the Enchanters are with us.
If Enchanter Master Xylotyl is party to our plans, he will give you his symbol as proof.
Likewise, the Conjurers might suspect us Necromancers of some nasty undertaking. Take my symbol to mistress Haze in Perfection to show my dedication.
Blood and bile! You managed to get the Enchanter symbol from Xylotyl. I feel secure in letting young Mortimer join you.
You can probably find Mortimer in the Guild Hall on the hill to the north of the city.
I am pleased that my master has given me permission to join you. I have been dying to get out of this dead town and see the world.
I am considered unusually pleasant for a Necromancer, so we should have no trouble getting along.
Hello Sorcerer. Master Flemm has told me of your quest. You might need my particular talents.
I can't let you in there. Flemm is conducting a very important private burial.
No, but if you will fill in for me tonight on courier duty I will let you in to talk to Flemm. He might be able to help you.
I have a hot date for tonight's seance, so if you could get the corpse out of the lab upstairs and bring it to old Tsalami's grave, I'd really appreciate it.
If the lab door is locked, ask around upstairs for the key. If you need directions to the grave, ask around town about the CITY.
Remember, you have to take the body to the grave at night!
Shhhh, have respect for the recently departed. Can't you see this is a private burial? Go away.
I'm the custodian around here... and let me tell you something bub. These Necromancers say they ain't evil... but for my money... they sure ain't good.
Welcome to HEC... Headquarters for Embalming Corpses.
You shouldn't be snooping around here Sorcerer. This place is not healthy for those who aren't fond of death.
You really shouldn't be here, but I see that our mutual friend at HEC has convinced you to take his courier duty.
That's fine by me, but just don't go poking your nose into Necromancer business.
Remember, a body is just a shell for the soul.
I'm second in charge here at the Headquarters for Embalming Corpses.
I last saw the key to the lab while searching for my copy of "The Fine Art of Mummification" in the bookshelves.
Hey Sorcerer... join me for a drink?
No one around here likes to talk about Old Tsalami's grave, but I have no problem talking. Its up on the big hill to the south around 15'6" 18'3".
Welcome to my Temple. Over on the far side of the Temple souls have been converted to evil. However, there is a way to save them -- a QUEST.
It is said that there is a way to save those who have gone over to Void. Religious research is best begun at the Great Cathedral.
Consult the confessional at the Great Cathedral. He stands on the symbol of Nexus. Ask them about this quest.
Sssorcerer! Your mind has been filled with lies about my order. Void wantsss the bessst for man. Pay him in pain and eternal pleassure ssshall be yoursss!
If you are like looking for master Xylotyl, you'll have a hard time finding him without his secretary. Check the cell in the Temple.
Pain is the true way. Pain! PAIN!! I used to slave for Xylotyl, but now I live for Void.
Where am I? Hey, get me out of this cage! Get me a Bingo card from the Tower of Kaos, I'm going into withdrawl.
That's me? I look terrible. Quick, bring me a bingo card from the Tower!
I gotta have that mirror. As long as I can see my image, the head Void priest can't convince me that I like pain.
Look, I REALLY need a bingo card, okay?
Rauchous!
Go and tell Xylotyl I'm back to normal. He's on top of the Tower of Kaos every night.
Xylotyl said I should join you for a while.
Xylotyl may change his mind any second -- we'd better scram.
Hey Sorcerer! Let's party sometime.
In order to be saved, a soul lost to Void must reflect upon his sins in a holy mirror. Check the library upstairs for a reference, west wall, south end.
Greetings, Sorcerer. Thalmus' death was most unfortunate, but he was wise to entrust his work to you.
Take my Symbol to Flemm in the City of Blood and tell him I'm with him.
Also, get the symbol of the Conjurers from Mistress Haze in the City of Perfection.
If the Conjurers give you their symbol, and you show it to me, then I can trust that they support this quest as well. We will need their help.
Support for the quest is strong indeed. Take one of my young Enchanters with you.
You'll find him "studying" at the Drunken Dragon to the south of Blood. He calls himself Obliky. Go on now, before I change my mind.
Master Xylotyl has changed his mind -- Obliky is no longer yours to take. Will you challenge us?
Well I don't care, I don't like you anyway. I think its time for you to die.
Bye Bye!
Next number... 59
then we have, lets see... 32
I'm the Bingoteer, do you want a card for 10 gold?
Hmmm, its on me somewhere...
Here you go, one Bingo card.
I can't talk! Can't you see I'm trying to play Bingo! If you want a Bingo card press the Bingoteer.
I'm sorry, you must have reservations to eat here. Come back some other time, we're full.
Sorry, I can't help you, I have six orders to get in the kitchen. Talk to the Maitre'Di.
Isn't this place great? I come here all the time.
Welcome to the Perfect Library. Please don't rumple the books.
Please do not disturb me, I am contemplating the fountains. They have a lovely sound.
The flames tell me that I shall join you on your quest. It may be that you will have need of me.
My mistress says that I have great potential but little skill yet. I see that we will be tested on this journey.
Haze has given me a great ruby to aid you in your quest. It is called the "Eye of Nexus."
Hello there Sorcerer. My name is Alexi, I'm an initiate here at the Guild. A vision has shown me that you are on an important mission.
I regret that Thalmus' death has thrown us into such disarray.
Hello Buc, is your quest going well?
Like my brethren at the other guilds I must be assured of guild loyalty.
Here is my symbol as a token of Conjurer commitment to the plan.
Show me the Necromancer symbol and I shall allow a young Conjurer to join your quest.
Perfect! The symbol of the Necromancers.
Downstairs is a young Conjurer named Alexi. Talk to her and she will join you.
Hello. I see you are from the Academy and that your quest has lead you to Haze. She is upstairs, but she doesn't want to be disturbed.
Haze is meditating. Most of the staff has gone to the restaurant. You really ought to go there sometime.
Haze has told me that Thalmus of the Academy -- may his soul rest in peace -- was working with her. She would probably like to see you, but not right now.
The door over there is an Ideal Door; it is soundproofed, and cannot be opened without the key.
You will want to get in and see Mistress Haze, but you need the key to the Ideal Door. I know where it is, but I want something in return.
I am working on a new spell and I need some flame wood. You can find out about flame wood at the Perfect Library. Come back when you have some.
Oh, the wood! Finally I will be able to test my new spell. For this I will risk the displeasure of my Guildmistress.
Take the Conjurer Key -- it opens the door to the Guild.
I have been working on an interesting water spell here at the oasis. It involves the rare Flame Wood.
Flame wood can only be found in the Fire Cave. The cave is south of Cathedral and can only be approached by boat.
There's a chest in the cave, but it is magically sealed. I spoke once with a man who knew this; his name is Larry and he frequents the Lobotomy Club.
So you are looking to find some Flame Wood, eh? You will need the Fire Key to open the magic chest in the cave. I had it for a while, but I sold it.
Would you like to buy me a drink?
Thanks. Anyway, I sold the key to this funny old Conjurer. He said he was from the far north, lives on a little island there, around 8' 5'.
Hi fellow, you look like you've traveled some. Stay away from the Fire Swamp to the south of here! There's a nasty witch there.
Her name is Hideous, but her name doesn't fit her anymore. If a Witch has a lock of your hair, she can steal your face.
She stole the good looks from some poor lass. Then Hideous cut off her own finger and put her life in it.
Until the finger is broken, she's almost immortal. But break that little bone and her life is over.
Just before dying, a witchhunter I met told me that she hid her finger bone somewhere in the swamp in front of, and very close to, her home.
Someone stole my precious. My little Ogre's Egg. The nasty Conjurers of the South Ice Cave stole my Perfect egg. I'll trade you the key for my egg.
Those nasty Conjurers live in a cave shaped like a giant skull. It can be found around 6' 21' on the south ice plane.
Oh, my precious, my lovely Egg. All mine! All mine! Deal's off Sorcerer, but I keep the Egg, hee hee... Come and get the key if you want it...
Hello lost soul, I am the Great Confessional. Confess your sins to me and you shall be forgiven.
Sorry, you can't go in there, King's orders. But if you donate all your money to the Doggon Throne I'll let you in. What do you say?
Thank you very much.
Do you want a receipt? Ha ha ha ha ha...
No entrance without the Regent's express permission!
I don't talk to plebs like you. If you have completed a quest for me I might give you a momment of my time.
Welcome to my city pleb. I am the appointed Regent of King Doggon XXIV of Doggania. I will bless you with but a moment of my time.
A quest Pleb, for the throne. Our Great King is sick, and I seek a champion. However I am still in the screening process.
Those who wish to be candidates shall consult my judge, in this building, about the quest. Begone now pest. Talk to me again if you have completed it.
According to my jailer you got Fiver. You are now eligible for the main quest. Our king is sick and only the Milk of Youth can help.
No one knows much about the milk, but the priests in town might know something...
So, you found the Milk of Youth. How nice. I'll see the king gets it.
By the way, Fiver didn't cheat at poker. But I hate to lose, so I had you kill him for me.
As a reward, I'll give you the run of the palace. Now run along boy.
This is my town now.
All mine!
Sorry sonny, I don't talk through closed doors. Come in and pull up a chair.
I fell very strange. Am I the King? What do I do?
Hi Boy, its good to be cured. How goes your quest?
I'm the King, but I'm under some sort of spell that the evil Regent put on me. Now where was I? I need the Milk of Youth.
Can you get me some... what did I ask you for? Oh yes, break the spell, kill the Regent, get me some milk.
I feel much better now -- I can remember!
You got me the Milk of Youth, that must mean that the Regent is dead. He put me under a spell. I thank you.
Here take this old ring. My father's father owned it and it's very valuable.
I think it's called Division -- I'm still a little foggy...
Hello friend. I am the local Magistrate. I can only talk for a short while.
So, you quest for the King? The quest of the day is to eradicate an enemy of the state, the evil merchant Fiver. Consult the jailer about the QUEST for details.
Fiver is a merchant from the City of Commerce, and he's wanted for cheating  the Regent at poker. He is rumored to be hiding at a friends house in his city.
Find him, kill him, and then come back and talk to me. I will certify you if my agents confirm he's gone.
Good, you took care of that menace Fiver. My agents say he is reported missing. I'll tell the Regent.
Fiver is a nice guy. You don't need to kill him. When you find him ask him to leave the city and the jailer will never know.
Doggon's slime bucket Regent sent you, right? I swear I never cheated in poker. I won fare and square and now he wants to kill me.
I'll leave town, I'm outta here, just say the word. They'll never see me again. Do we have a deal?
Thanks. I owe you a million and Fiver never forgets his debts. I'll pay you back someday.
<Fiver darts out the door>
Please no, don't kill me over a card game. Just ask me to leave the city and I'll go.
Hello friend, I am the castle maid. Our poor king is sick and the city is in grave peril. I don't think the Regent is a very nice man.
The King stays in his room now and only the Iron key will open it. His nanny had the key. She lives in this city right next to the town sign.
You quest for the Regent. Do it not for him, but for the King. Your quest will be a quest of Division. Consult the lore.
We know Division involves a Division of Age and a Division of power. Seek wisdom in Cathedral.
Hello. Our daughter, Sarah, was once the nanny to the King, but she grew prematurely old and moved to the Sunset Retirement Home in the south.
I lost the Key! Now we can't go downstairs and play! Wait, maybe I left it on the dresser by the bed down the street!
Help me! I am really from Doggania, but an evil witch named Hideous stole my beauty. She took a lock of my hair for her spell -- can you help me get it back?
Thank you so much, I can never repay you.
Take this key from me, it will let you into the King's chambers in the Doggon Castle. The king needs help.
I must be off to return to my family.
Don't hurt me master, please don't hurt me! Are you going to kill me?
Aaarararrahahhhah! Please don't!
Thank you master! I'll tell you where the witch's bone is. Search in the muck at the south east corner here. I saw her hide it in the muck.
Trespasser, prepare to become my slave!
You snap the bone in two. The witch shimmers and becomes ugly. Then she collapses into a pile of goo!
Hello young Sorcerer. Welcome to my city. Imino has told me much about you and the Academy. I was sorry to hear about your master.
I am the Queen. I control all that you see.
I have brought enlightenment back to the world.
Thanks for your help with the lens, Buc. If I can do anything for you just ask -- and keep me updated on your quest.
We are doing such interesting things in Richi. I have built a new observatory to the west. Unfortuantly we have yet to get a lens for the big telescope.
The telescope in our new observatory is all up and running, thanks to you.
I think I might be able to help you get the Ring of Advancing, but first you must do me a favor and get me a lens for the observatory.
My ancestor, the first Richi King, was said to have had the Ring of Advancing. His crypt is below the south east tower.
No one has been able to get into the crypt in years because its lock is enchanted and needs a special key. You might look into it at Cathedral.
Hello Buc, good to see you. After Thalmus was killed I found myself outside this town. The Queen has taken me on as her personal Sorcerer.
It is Dreadful what happened to the Master, he was such a good man. A waste of a great talent too! I have tried to look into the mystery of the Rings.
The Queen says she knows where the Ring of Advancing is, but I think she is just humoring me. Ask her about our QUEST.
I am the science master here at the castle. Under the Queen's enlightened rule we are investigating the real nature of the universe. Observe our "machine."
Hello sir, welcome to the Observatory. Unfortunately bandits have prevented us from getting a lens for the telescope.
Here are the plans for the lens. Take them to Shard in the south and have them make it at the Great Glassworks.
Welcome to the Great Observatory sir. Thanks to you we will now be able to study the stars in the finest detail!
Thanks so much. You have worked a miracle -- we've been trying to get this lens for over a year.
When I get this lens fitted into the telescope we shall have a wonderous view of the heavens.
I will tell the Queen of your great favor. I'm sure she will be pleased.
Why Hello. I am a humble monk here. Like my colleague to the left I study the Rings of Power. My specialty is the Ring of Advancement.
The litany of Advancement reads: "The Test of Advancement is overcome by thoroughness of motion."
I am sure that means that there is a trick to it. The straightforward approach will not work. Try covering all bases.
Please don't disturb me. I am reading up on the nature of Force.
Listen to this: It says here that an object repelled by force from a surface can have its polarity reversed by touching all points on the surface!
Hello Buc. Fancy meeting you here!
It seems that the Ring was real after all. Old Richi had it on him all the time!
I hate to do this Buc, but if you want this Ring you're going to have to take it from me.
I am the master glass blower -- I supervise all the work that goes on here. We make the finest crystal in the world!
I am the master blower here. I supervise all the work that goes on here. We make the finest crystal in the world!
I see you want a great lens. Hmmm, this is a tricky job. I will require two things:
First, as payment I would like a bundle of tomes from Cathedral. Second, I'll  need something to make the lens out of.
To make the lens you want I'll need magic sand. You can find it only in the city of Mesa in the Great Desert.
Thanks for the tomes -- I've been trying to get ahold of these for a while now.
If you have the magic sand show it to the glass blower up stairs. He'll make the lens for you -- I gave him the specs already.
I am the assistant glass blower. I do all the work while the Master supervises.
Yes, this is the magic sand from Mesa -- you don't see stuff like this every day!
Here's your lens -- a fine piece if I do say so myself.
Hello friend. I am just reading up on the Ring of Bile.
The Book of Bile says - "Where Dead and Living meet, where those who go are quick on their feet, Bile will be there to Greet." Don't ask ME what it means.
If you are interested in the Rings of Power be sure to talk to Curtis out in the grave yard (16'7" 16'4") -- he's an expert on the Ring of Bile.
Well you've tracked me down. I was hoping to avoid you -- I don't like live people much.
Of course. Void gave the Ring of Bile to a Black Priest named Pain, who later died and was buried in a great tomb. The Ring is on his body.
Unfortuantly the location of the tomb is not known to me. There are two ways in which you might be able to find it.
First: The Ring of Bile is a powerful gate to the Dead Lands and has been in one place for a long time -- the dimensional boundaries around it may have ripped.
The result of that would be an area in which the dead can walk easily on earth and the living suffer the fate of the dead.
Second: The Black Priests have records as to the location of the Tomb. Show one of them the symbol of Void (the whip), and he may tell you where it is.
Greetings wayfarer. I am the keeper of the Great Tomb. Abandon Hope All Ye Who Enter Here!
I guard the entrance to the Great Tomb. I might allow you to enter if you would end this mockery of a life I lead.
Alas, I can not be killed -- I am cursed with Protection. However, if you show me the words of a powerful spell it may be strong enough to break the protection.
Consult with the most powerful Necromancers in the world to find a spell to loosen the bonds of a dead man's grip on this world.
Could this be it? Yes, praise be the forces that created the planes.
Thank you kind sir... Enter the Tomb, but do not tarry, the Tomb holds only death for mortals...
<He disapears>
I am Lucius, the greatest Necromancer in the world.
I have created a brilliant new spell called RAISE which allows the soul of a corpse to be bound to the body, bringing it back to life.
Perhaps it could also dispel the undead. Unfortunately I am missing the primary ingredient: the mustache of a thespian.
Aha! The false mustache of a thespian! Just a moment...
Here you go! One super powerful Necromancer spell. Make sure you tell everyone that you have the latest from Lucius -- it pays to advertise, you know!
Welcome to our humble theatre. I hope you will stay for our little show.
I am a performing artist in the theatre.
So you want to see our show? Please, sit down! Wait a sec, hold on to this false mustache of mine. I don't need it for this play.
No, I have no information for you. However, the Master Enchanter Tutu might. He lives in a tower in the eastern Great Desert.
Hello friend. I am just reading up on the Ring of Variation.
The Book of Variation says - "Life and Death shift in eternal Variation, however the test is passed by the scholar, not the athlete."
The "Key to Variation" is merely this: "Start on the third square from the south wall and proceed according to the Order of Variation."
Stop Invader! I didn't invite you into my tower. FREEZE!
That will teach you not to trespass in the tower of the Great Enchanter Tutu! Now rot forever in my cell!
Why hello Buc, fancy meeting you here. It's Fiver. I'm doing some work for Tutu, but since you helped me out when I was in need, I'll give you a hand.
I have something that might help you on your quest. Our order has an ancient document pertaining the the Rings in our vault.
Unfortunately the key to the chest was lost in a raid by warriors of the the city of Sparta. If you can recover it you are welcome to the document.
MUTATION is "WWWSSWW, NNNNEEE, N to wall"
ALTERATION is "WWSWWN, W to wall, SSEEE"
RANDOMNESS is "S to wall, W to wall, NNENNNWW"
Die thief!
Halt intruder, you are not welcome here!
I have nothing to tell you now. However if you prove your dedication to the Art of Sorcery by learning the MIRAGE spell, I will tell you something useful.
The best place to look for the spell would be Magic B Us.
Years ago the Ring of Intuition was kept here, but the great dragon  Flamory attacked the Academy, killed many Sorcerers, and stole the Ring.
The survivors were driven insane by the fury of Flamory's attack and sent to Oxbridge to recover. Some of them might still be there.
Many people come to our city to rest. The Sorcerers came here after the dragon Flamory raided their city, and sought refuge in their guild.
Those that did not stay within the guild settled in town or eventually left.
Greetings, Buc. I too hail from the City of the Mind. I and my comrades fled here after a dragon pillaged our home many years ago.
Only one who can unlock my thoughts can ever hope to find the missing Ring of Intuition.
I don't remember what I do. I wrote it down on a scrap of paper but I seem to have lost it. Look around for the scrap, will you?
I am a Sorcerer. I came to town with two of my fellow guildsmen after the dragon Flamory attacked our city.
My friends and I had a treasure map, but it was lost. If you find it and give it to me I'll tell you where the lost Sorcerer can be found.
Visit the man on the Island of light at night. The way is open only when the world is asleep. Try 13'6" 4'7".
There is a thief upstairs who just came back from Oxbridge. No thief ever returns from a city without some of its treasures.
So you think I stole something in Oxbridge. Well you're right!
Open Sesame!
My friend in Oxbridge lost my Orb. If you return it to me I'll give you the Intuition Key. This will aide you on your quest for the Ring of Intuition.
Thank you for my lost orb. Here, take the Intuition key.
The key should open the dragon Flamory's cave. Show it to my comrades in Oxbridge, they might remember where the beast's lair is.
I see you got the key to the dragon's cave. I will tell you a story:
"Over rolling seas of sand shall the hero go with key in hand, search neither high nor low to discover the path aglow..."
"Near where the world of the life, meets the world of death, In the Fire Dragon's Tower, You'll find a Ring of Power."
By the way, if you are interested. You can give me a little money for my nice plump dove.
Here you go, one nice plump dove.
Growwlll! I'm hungry. A little white bird might be nice...
Ah, a dove. Delicious, thank you. Here take your pick from my treasure horde.
A nice shiny Ring of Power. Doesn't fit on my claw anyway.
Go away, before I get hungry again!
This might help you. A conjurer in here last week told me that an old woman who lives behind the water fall at 30'1" 5'4" is an expert on the Ring of Calling.
So, you're looking for the Rings. I know where the Ring of Calling is, but I will only tell you if you find my lost crystal ball.
The ball was stolen by the crew of the pirate ship Ahab. Find her and you will find it. Start first at the Bandit Hole.
You can find that Bandit cess pool at 30' 18'.
Thank you for recovering my crystal ball. It's irreplacable for my visions. Let's take a look now...
I see great forces aligned against each other. I see choices that must be made, sides that must be taken. Here, take the Ring.
Magicnia has been cut off by a terrible band of pirates, terrible. I'll tell you what. I have a treasure map that might interest you.
Kill 5 bands of pirates and take their flags. Bring them to me and USE them. Then, I will give you the map. You'll find pirates in the waters just off our coast.
Ahoy there matey! Here for a pull of grog? Join old Red Beard for a drink.
So matey, you got the other half of me treasure map.
I'll tell you what, I'll give you my half for 100 gold. Is it a deal?
Well then, you'll just have to kill me for it. But I warn ya, I'm mighty nasty with the cutlas!
Good, I like a man who makes a deal.
This map will lead you right to the Ahab. Blimey, was I sorry when she sank.
I am the Keef, the King of Thieves. Have you heard my story?
I was born an abused child on another world. I was turned out into the jungle, But by great personal strength I became emperor of my whole world.
I was a master warrior, a master thief, and a master mage. Unfortunately I was out fishing in a dingy when I rowed off the edge of that world.
I fell through space for weeks, eating only shoe leather, and landed here on this world. I used my considerable skills and charisma to achieve my present position.
I found the Ring of Will in a bagel I was eating one day. You can't take it from me, but I'll make a deal with you.
Bring me the leaf from the Fluffi tree of Gomez. It is said to make any true thief the best thief in the universe.
I have no idea where you can find the Fluffi Tree of Gomez, but I heard that a lunatic held at the Asylum went questing for it.
You actually found the leaf -- amazing. Well, I'm really sorry, but I traded my Ring to a priest named Yoppa for a good luck charm.
He said he was going to the Great Cathedral with his prize. You can look for him there.
It's nice to see someone else questing. I used to do a lot of that in my youth.
When I came to this town they were nothings. I had to show them how to take candy from babies. Pathetic...
So Buc, you have tracked me here. I assume you are after the Ring of Will.
I am afraid so Yoppa. Give it to me and we will avoid a fight.
I wish I could, but I am under orders from the High Priest to deliver the Ring to the Temple.
The Temple is not all powerful, Yoppa. There are other forces in the universe. I must have that Ring.
Then I am afraid you must fight me for it...
Did you know that there is a Fluffi Tree of Gomez in a cave at 0'7" 19'2"?
Hello friend. I am not your average bear. I have worked hard at my studies to elevate my station in life.
I run a sucessful honey business -- the finest honey in the world. Here, have a sample.
I'm sorry, but only a true hero may gain entrance to the throne room of the great Fen Ho.
Welcome hero, vanquisher of our foul creator the evil witch Hideous. The mighty Fen Ho looks forward to meeting you.
Welcome, slayer of witches. I, the mighty Fen Ho am at your service.
I don't know much about the Rings of Power, but I am willing to send my scouts out to find the location of a Ring for such a mighty personage as you.
I will, of course, expect you to do me a favor in return. I am seeking a means of protecting my people against danger.
If you could secure a contract for us from the Protector's guild I would be much obliged.
I see you have gotten us a contract for protection.
I have fulfilled my end of the bargin and located the key to the Ring of Will. It is held by Keef the Thief, King of the Thieves, who demands in return a leaf.
This leaf is from the Fluffi tree of Gomez located in the center of a puzzle protected cave. This paper contains the solution to the puzzle.
I am the Lord Mistress of the Protectors' Citadel.
We protect people who hold contracts with us. We have a honey shortage of late. If you've got a honey comb, I'll gladly give you a contract.
The best honey in the world is made by a talking bear who lives in the great forest on the eastern coast of the east continent.
You are wise to take advantage of such a good deal.
Now, who is to be Protected? Ah, King Fen Ho of Fenopolis. It will be an honor.
Hello friend. I am a student of Mutation.
The Litany of Mutation says - "Fair is the Ring of Mutation, but its likeness is now only as thick as a hair. Expect the unexpected, and beware!"
I've heard that a mutated object or person must be shown the image of its  original form in order to be restored.
The Ring of Mutation mutated into the form of a human being to hide itself. Talk to other Enchanter Guildmasters for more information.
A wandering Conjuror told me that she had met a woman in an inn somewhere who's aura was that of the Ring of Mutation.
I'm not what I seem, Sorcerer. I am power incarnate, bound to this weak form for eternity, it seems.
Hey, that picture is of my real shape.
I am returned unto my orginal form.
It is a statue of Nexus. You can see that it is missing one of its two ruby eyes.
You insert the Eye of Nexus into the empty socket and the statue begins to speak.
"Congratulations hero, but rest not -- your trials have just begun. Take this scroll to the house of Bob in Sunrise." The eye falls out of the socket.
My family has been waiting here for generations to fulfil the prophecy of Nexus. He has a great task for us.
The time has come. My lot in life, so I thought, was to pass the message to my own son, but alas, I don't have one. You can imagine my relief at your arrival.
You have given me the command of Nexus, and so I will give you his message.
Show me that with which you began.
Good you may go on.
Show me the symbol of despair.
Good you may go on.
Tough as armor, found inside, bring me protection that is not hide.
Good you may go on.
Show me a vessle of fluid containment.
Good you may go on.
Show me that which came from Nexus.
Good you may go on.
Welcome to the Shady Rest Funeral Home! Take home a nice body for loved ones today! Can I make YOU a DEAL!
Hello. I'm researching the nature of Perfection.
Here is a bit from the literature: "Satisfy both those who dwell in the light and those dwell in the dark and Perfection shall be yours."
Necromancer's are great embalmers. They have a secret lab. I visited once and they gave me a pass. I still have it around here somewhere.
Hello Sorcerer. I'm an expert on Perfection.
Years ago the Temple kept the Ring of Perfection here. However, that was deemed too dangerous so it was moved to a secret location.
If you look around here on the shelves you might find some record of it.
I'm one of the guardians of the Ring of Perfection. It is sealed away safely. I might help your quest along if you did me a favor.
I have an especially important funeral coming up soon and I need some special embalming fluids for the body. I don't know exactly who makes them.
Try looking it up at the university library and see if you can get some for me.
Thank you for the embalming supplies. They are very useful for a funeral.
I shouldn't do this but you can have my key. Don't tell the boss back at the Great Cathedral. The sun gem opens half of the way to Perfection.
No one enters here without a pass. Prepare to die.
I see you have a pass. Go on in.
Greetings. I'm busy working on an experiment right now. I take it you want some embalming fluids.
There will be no charge for the fluids. A Necromancer never gets in the way of a good embalming job.
I am the head researcher into the chemical side of Necromancy.
Like my brother the Sun Priest I am a guardian of the Ring of Perfection. Temple policy dictates that I should not help you.
However I sense that you are a good man and the plight of my people is desperate. Warriors of Sparta attack us frequently and have killed many.
Take my message to the Spartan king and get his agreement to stop this slaughter and I will help you find the Ring.
Thank you for negotiating on the behalf of my people. You can find the Moon gem hidden in the center of our pool of foam on the top floor of the temple.
I am the King of Sparta. May the strongest survive!
So, those pathetic fools want mercy. Well, only the strong survive! Why should I honor the request of a weakling like you? Prove yourself in my arena!
Your triumph in the arena entitles you to a favor. If you choose to waste it on the Moon people then so be it.
You can't enter the arena until the King has given you permission.
Very well, you may enter. To be victorious, you must kill both the bears and the dragons. Talk to the King when you are done.
So we meet again, Buc. I have been waiting here for someone to show up and help me open the trap and get the Ring of Perfection.
Unfortunately, both the Sun and the Moon gems are needed to free the Ring.
I have both of the gems Fezzik.
Good, then let me help you get the Ring.
The two of you each take a gem and fit it into the slots at opposite ends of the room. Suddenly a Ring materializes in the center of the chamber.
The Ring of Perfection. I'm afraid you're out of luck, Buc. This Ring is mine.
The Ring of Blood has been found by an evil Necromancer. His men are said to be gamblers. Check out the casino on the artic coast, around 24' 21'.
A group of Knights came in here a while back for a big game. They lost a lot of money, so they trashed the place. Speaking of money could you loan me some?
Thanks. The Knights told me that if I needed to get in touch with them I should meet their contact person, the tall one named Carl. Here's his card.
I am an agent for the mighty Power Lord. I can set up a meeting with his main man, but I need my finders fee.
Talk to Mean Dean at the Lobotomy Club. He can tell you the location of the Power Lord's base of operations.
Are you setting me up for a hit? I work for the Power Lord, so don't get any ideas. I got my Power Lord ID on me, and that's worth its weight in gold.
Hello Sorcerer. I study the history of the Rod of Creation.
The Rings of Power are made out of pieces of the Rod of Creation. It is said that the Rod could be reassembled if all of the pieces were brought to Nexus.
Nexus has not left his sanctuary on the Fount of Heaven since the Cataclysm. It's a huge building atop the tallest mountain in the world.
The only way to get there is to fly. It is also said that man will not be able to enter until he possesses all eleven Rings and uses the Holy Seal.
The Holy Seal was once kept here in the Cathedral, but it was stolen by bandits years ago and no one knows where they took it.
Why, hello Sorcerer, welcome to my manor. Enjoy yourself. Let no one say that Mr. Belmont is a poor host.
I am a business man. I run a business. This makes me an expert dealer. I offer people a deal they can not refuse.
So you're looking for the Rings of Power. That is a Quest for a man with a lot of time on his hands, and a lot of courage. Me, I prefer business.
Well, as long as you're questing, you might do me a favor. There's only one town whose citizens have not yet joined my organization.
That town is Mesa. I'm curious about it, as you might have guessed. If you learn anything, let me know. I'll owe you one.
So you found out why those folks at Mesa are not interested in me. Facinating.
You've done me a service. I'll give you the run of my house. If you're interested in joining up, just let me know.
Sand is the source of our power here; it flows up from the Mesa. You can find some of our special sand in the north west corner of the Mesa.
I watch the magic sand well up from the center of the earth. It is strongest over there on that little hill.
No admittance without Bandit ID.
Very well, your ID looks okay, go on in.
Hello again, Buc. Good to see you. I know I shouldn't do this, but since you saved old Lenny's life, I'll let you into the treasury. Don't tell anybody.
Hey Buc -- thanks again for letting me out of that smelly cell in the City of Speed.
Why hello there Buc, I've been waiting for you. You see, It all came to me just after our master zapped me to some random location in the artic.
The best way to get the Rings of Power was to sit back and let everyone else do all the work. Then when you showed up here I would retreive them.
So I have been living it up at Kaos for past few months, while you, and the four other suckers ran around the world finding my Rings for me.
Imino managed to find the Ring of Advancing, but of course you took that from him in Richi.
Poor old Yoppa went to all that trouble to find the Ring of Will and bring it back to the Cathedral. But you also took his Ring.
Now my friend Fezzik, I told him to wait in the Chamber of Perfection, and sure enough you came along with the gems. Too bad you had to kill him.
Roakus, on the other hand, was a surprise failure. He didn't manage to get a single Ring. But instead, he spent his time lounging in the Lobotomy Club.
I don't know what Master Thalmus saw in him.
You on the other hand, were an unprecedented success. You managed to secure all eleven of the Rings. And now... you have brought them here to me.
Thank you.
But Darius, you have made one fatal mistake. For I, in obtaining the Rings, also learned of their powers and can now use them against you.
Allied with Nexus, this is not a power that even you can overcome.
No, Buc, it is you who have made the tactical blunder. For I have a secret up my sleave, which I shall be happy to tell you...
VOID! And the spells he has crafted for your destruction. Give my regards to the rest of the gang when you meet them: In the dead lands...
Die Sssorcerer sscum!
What do you want, Filth? Have you come to bow down before my massster VOID the Dessstroyer?
Pain formsss the junction between worldsss. Pain will bring Void the Dessstroyer to sssave us.
Pain! Pain! Sssuffering! Misery! Pain!
Void is my masster. Join him or die. Your pain sshall add to the magnitude of his entrance into thiss world.
Reap the whirlwind!
Void created uss long ago to ssserve him.
